description: This file defines the DumpPool class, which manages a thread pool for executing dump tasks in the Android dumpstate system. It includes functions for enqueuing tasks, managing temporary files, and controlling thread execution, as well as related utility functions and class declarations.

classes.name: DumpPool
classes.description: A thread pool class for executing dump tasks concurrently, with methods for task management, thread control, and temporary file handling.

methods.name: WaitForTask
methods.description: Waits for a dump task to complete and dumps its result to a specified file descriptor or STDOUT.

methods.name: DumpPool
methods.description: Constructor for creating a thread pool with a specified temporary root directory.

methods.name: ~DumpPool
methods.description: Destructor that waits for all threads to exit before destroying the pool.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the thread pool with a specified number of threads.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task to be executed by the thread pool, returning a future for the task's result.

methods.name: enqueueTaskWithFd
methods.description: Enqueues a task that takes a file descriptor as a parameter, returning a future.

methods.name: deleteTempFiles
methods.description: Deletes temporary files created by the thread pool.

methods.name: setLogDuration
methods.description: Enables or disables logging of task durations for testing.
